nexus_mcp_url.title: Your Nexus MCP URL
nexus_mcp_url.description: MCP endpoint of YOUR Plotune Nexus device: http://<device-ip>/mcp on the same LAN/VPN, or https://<device-uuid>.plotune.net/mcp through its managed tunnel. The device UUID is in the Nexus local UI under device information.
